🤔 Here's a quick guide to choosing the right plan:

👨‍🎓 Student / Occasional user → Free Plan (₹0) – 5 checks, basic report

📚 Student / Researcher → Student Plan (₹599/mo) – 100 checks, detailed reports, grammar checker

🧑‍💼 Professional / Small Team → Professional Plan (₹1,499/mo) – Unlimited checks, API, bulk checking

🏛️ University / Large Org → Enterprise Plan (Custom) – Unlimited everything + SSO + dedicated manager

See the full comparison at https://plagpro.com/pricing or ask me about any specific plan!
